web-prod::web:smoke::verify the navigati.title: Verify the navigation header renders correctly across all supported locales
web-prod::web:smoke::verify the navigati.label: SCRIPT
web-prod::web:smoke::verify the navigati.note: Language switch fired while the Liquidity League page was still navigating so the language panel never opened; on retry the Strategies page exceeded the test's 15s header wait.

decisions.label: SCRIPT
decisions.note: Language switch fired while the Liquidity League page was still navigating so the language panel never opened; on retry the Strategies page exceeded the test's 15s header wait.

rca.detail: setLocale fires while the Liquidity League page is still navigating so the language panel never opens; on retry the Strategies page exceeds the test's 15s header wait (raised to 30s in PR 1348).
rca.prevention: Never switch locale mid-navigation: return to the trading page before each switch, and size header waits to production load times rather than staging's.

web-prod::web:smoke::verify the navigati.key: web-prod::web:smoke::verify the navigation header stays identical across repeated reloads
web-prod::web:smoke::verify the navigati.title: Verify the navigation header stays identical across repeated reloads
web-prod::web:smoke::verify the navigati.label: SCRIPT
web-prod::web:smoke::verify the navigati.note: Strategies header renders 3 items before APY data lands and 4 after, so the baseline fingerprint is captured loaded while post-reload snapshots are captured unloaded.

decisions.label: SCRIPT
decisions.note: Strategies header renders 3 items before APY data lands and 4 after, so the baseline fingerprint is captured loaded while post-reload snapshots are captured unloaded.

rca.detail: The Strategies header renders 3 items before APY data lands and 4 after, so the baseline is fingerprinted loaded while post-reload snapshots are fingerprinted unloaded.
rca.prevention: Fingerprint the header only once it stops changing — two consecutive reads of item count and labels must match before the snapshot is taken.

web-testnet::web:smoke::verify trade-ind.title: Verify Trade-Indicators data for all instruments is rendered as expected
web-testnet::web:smoke::verify trade-ind.label: SCRIPT
web-testnet::web:smoke::verify trade-ind.note: Checking every instrument across two parallel browsers exceeds the testnet API rate limit and KORU-USDT returns error 1015; the suite's own load causes the failure.

decisions.label: SCRIPT
decisions.note: Checking every instrument across two parallel browsers exceeds the testnet API rate limit and KORU-USDT returns error 1015; the suite's own load causes the failure.

rca.detail: The test walks every instrument across two parallel browsers, which exceeds the testnet API rate limit; KORU-USDT returns error 1015 and the render assertion fails.
rca.prevention: Cap the concurrency this test runs at (one browser) and add a backoff between instrument calls, so the suite's own load can never trip the rate limiter.
